meta.author: Sudan Geopolitical Analyst
meta.scope: VERIFY badges in modern-era extents (South Sudan, December Revolution, War in Sudan, al-Bashir), extents_notes_fill_ss2011.json, and modern items in extents_historic.json. Read-only; extents not edited.
meta.finding: All 10 VERIFY badges are the same note, field abyei.final_status 'Final status unresolved.', cited only to 2011–2013 UN documents (UNSC1990, S/2013/706). They need a current UN source before being shown as present-day.
meta.rules: No territorial-control claims; legal/status texts only. Quotes as read.
meta.out_of_scope: db/extents/southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.geojson features/4 carries the same VERIFY note, but that era is not modern, so it is not assessed here.

items.existing_cite: UNSC1990 p.3 OP9; UNSG_S2013_706 p.3 paras 11–12

new_cites.cite: UN Meetings Coverage SC/16212, 'With Abyei's Final Status Still Hanging, Security Council Urges Sudan, South Sudan to De-escalate Violence…', briefing by ASG Martha Ama Akyaa Pobee, 5 Nov 2025
new_cites.quote: The political process between Sudan and South Sudan on Abyei and border issues remains stalled, as it has been since the outbreak of the Sudan conflict in April 2023
new_cites.read: full page via WebFetch 2026-10-25

new_cites.cite: UN Security Council resolution 2802 (2025), S/RES/2802(2025), adopted 14 Nov 2025; extends UNISFA to 15 Nov 2026
new_cites.quote: Determines that both parties should demonstrate measurable progress on border demarcation
new_cites.read: resolution text excerpt via search extract 2026-10-25 (also press.un.org/en/2025/sc16223.doc.htm)

items.note: Two current UN texts (Nov 2025) show that Abyei's final status is still unsettled. Add both to the note's cite and drop VERIFY. Suggested wording: 'Final status unresolved (as of Nov 2025).' Re-check after the next UNISFA renewal (mandate ends 15 Nov 2026).
